body.value:
Thank you for giving faithfully and helping us make a difference together. Every gift—large or small—is meaningful and appreciated.

“Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.” — 2 Corinthians 9:7

感谢您忠心的奉献，与我们一同带来改变。无论多少，每一份奉献都宝贵，我们都心存感恩。

「各人要随本心所酌定的，不要作难，不要勉强，因为捐得乐意的人是神所喜爱的。」——哥林多后书 9:7

Give securely with a debit card, credit card, or your PayPal balance. Gifts go straight to the church's PayPal account, and PayPal emails you a confirmation right away.

You can set up a one-time or recurring gift from the same page.

您可以使用借记卡、信用卡或 PayPal 余额安全奉献。款项会直接进入教会的 PayPal 帐户，PayPal 也会立即发送确认邮件给您。

您可以在同一页面设定单次或定期奉献。

Zelle transfers carry no processing fees, so the full amount of your gift reaches the church.

Open Zelle in your bank's app, scan the QR code, and follow the prompts to send your gift.

使用 Zelle 转帐不会产生手续费，您奉献的金额会全数进入教会。

请在您银行的应用程式中打开 Zelle，扫描二维码，并按照提示完成奉献。

imageAlt.value: Zelle QR code for Bread of Life Christian Church
生命面包基督教会 Zelle 二维码

body.value:
Bring your gift to any Sunday service and hand it to Wendy, our book-keeper. Please make cheques payable to Bread of Life Christian Church.

Wendy records every gift she receives so that it can be receipted — let her know if you would like your receipt by email.

您可以在任何一次主日聚会中，把奉献亲手交给我们的会计 Wendy。支票抬头请写 Bread of Life Christian Church。

Wendy 会记录每一笔收到的奉献以便开立收据；若您希望以电子邮件收取收据，请告知她。

Prefer to send a cheque? Mail it to:

Bread of Life Christian Church
123 Hope Street, Springfield, ST 00000

Please do not send cash by mail.

若您希望邮寄支票，请寄至：

Bread of Life Christian Church
123 Hope Street, Springfield, ST 00000

请勿邮寄现金。

question.value: What happens to the money after I give?
奉献之后，这些款项如何使用？

children.text: Every gift goes into the church's general fund. Wendy, our book-keeper, records it, the treasurer reconciles the accounts, and the church board oversees how the fund is spent.
That fund pays for:
Sunday worship, our building, and day-to-day operating costs
Supporting our pastors and staff
Outreach, missions, and helping families in need in our community
Spending is reviewed regularly and summarised for the congregation.
每一笔奉献都会进入教会的总帐户。由会计 Wendy 记录，司库核对帐目，并由教会同工会监督款项的使用。
这些款项用于：
主日敬拜、教会场地及日常运作开支
支持我们的牧者与同工
社区关怀、宣教，以及帮助有需要的家庭
支出会定期审核，并向会众公布摘要。
If you give through Zelle, PayPal, cash, cheque, or mail, our treasurer records the gift and emails you a receipt within 2–3 business days.
We can also provide a year-end summary of your giving on request.
若您透过 Zelle、PayPal、现金、支票或邮寄奉献，我们的司库会记录该笔奉献，并在 2–3 个工作日内以电子邮件寄出收据。
如有需要，我们也可以提供年度奉献总结。

question.value: How can I get tax benefits?
奉献可以享有税务优惠吗？

children.text: Bread of Life Christian Church is a registered nonprofit religious organization, so gifts to the church are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.

Keep the receipts we email you, or ask us for a year-end giving statement, and you can claim your giving when you itemize deductions on your tax return. If you are unsure how this applies to your situation, please check with a tax professional.
生命面包基督教会是注册的非营利宗教机构，因此在法律允许的范围内，向教会的奉献可以抵税。
请保留我们寄给您的收据，或向我们索取年度奉献证明；报税时逐项列举扣除额即可申报。若不确定您的情况如何适用，建议咨询专业税务人员。

question.value: What if I want to give a large sum?
如果我想做一笔大额奉献呢？

children.text: Please contact Wendy, our book-keeper, before you give. If you feel called to give a large sum, she can talk through the options with you, answer questions about how the money would be used, and help connect your gift with the ministry, mission, or project you would like it to support.
若您感动要做一笔大额奉献，请先联系我们的会计 Wendy。她可以与您一同讨论合适的方式，说明款项的用途，并协助您把这份奉献用在您所希望支持的事工、宣教或项目上。
